title: Enterprise Support: Paid invoice corrected fee calculation for paid rate-error review
content:
Enterprise Support — Paid invoice corrected fee calculation for paid rate-error review.

## Decision basis

For paid rate-error review: Reconstruct eligible pretax compute spending as source vCPU-hours times effective cloud rate; multiply by the support fee fraction and by one minus its single selected support discount, apply the full-month support minimum last, then round the nonnegative corrected net fee half up to cents.

## Hypothetical case

For paid rate-error review: Suppose source exports hypothetically total 1000 vCPU-hours, effective cloud price is USD 0.50, support fraction is 20 percent, selected discount is 25 percent and full-month minimum is USD 90. The discounted amount is USD 75 and the minimum yields a corrected fee of USD 90.00. Discounting a fee after imposing its minimum would give a different result and is outside this order.
